From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@greenfield.io>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up on the retail benchmark you downloaded — quick walkthrough?

Hi Emily,

Thanks for downloading our 2026 Retail Inference Benchmark — I saw your download and wanted to offer a quick walkthrough of the numbers and how they map to Greenfield's expected throughput/cost profile. A short 30-minute call is usually enough to:

- Explain the benchmark methodology and relevant model variants
- Surface latency and cost tradeoffs for peak retail traffic
- Flag integration/infra considerations (KV cache, batching, private deployment)

If that sounds useful, would any of these work for you (I’m in PST):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:30–11:00 AM PT
- Tue Nov 10, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed Nov 11, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

I’ve attached a one-pager summary of the benchmark and a short mutual-action-plan template we can fill in after the call. I can include a solutions engineer (Marissa) if you want to cover infra questions.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?cid=GF-1109

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-retail-benchmark-onepager.pdf
From: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@greenfield.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T12:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on the retail benchmark you downloaded — quick walkthrough?

Hi Ben,

Thanks — yes, that would be useful. We’re evaluating options for Q1 traffic so I want to include our infra lead Raj Patel on the call to validate network and data-flow constraints. He’s cc’d on this reply.

The Tue Nov 10 times are tight for us. The Wed Nov 11 9:00–9:30 AM PT (that’s 12:00–12:30 PM ET) would work on our side if Marissa can join. If not, we could do Wed Nov 11 3:00–3:30 PM PT (6:00–6:30 PM ET), but earlier is better.

Also, can you confirm if the benchmark includes multi-tenant shared-runtime numbers vs. dedicated GPU pools?

Thanks,
Emily Thomas
Director of Engineering, Greenfield Retail
emily.thomas@greenfield.io

Emily — great, thanks for looping Raj in.

Marissa — adding you to the thread; could you join Wed Nov 11 at 9:00 AM PT for a 30-min infra fit sync? We’ll cover: benchmark methodology (shared vs dedicated), typical latency SLOs, and deployment options (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC).

If that time works, I’ll send a calendar invite to everyone. If not, propose an alternate 30-min window on Wed and I’ll update.

Quick answer to your question: the public benchmark PDF shows both shared-runtime (lower unit cost, some variance) and dedicated-reserved profile numbers — we’ll call out which numbers are which during the walkthrough. Marissa can bring precise cost-per-token delta numbers for dedicated capacity.

Ben
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
